native-monitor-regression.mechanism: Create and bring up a dummy link before Backend.StartMonitor. StartMonitor executes the actual monitor.start and seedLinkNames against that namespace. Issue exactly one native LinkSetDown and require interface/down for test0. No cache writes, synthetic events, startup priming, or sleep.
native-monitor-regression.red: Before-source handleLinkUpdate emits only created for the first RTM_NEWLINK and returns. The named down wait expires after monitorEventTimeout (5 seconds).
native-monitor-regression.green: The same first update emits created followed by down, and the named down wait succeeds.
native-monitor-regression.negative-control: Restore only the early return after EventCreated from the preserved monitor before-source while leaving the new test unchanged. The native test must fail; do not count a skip.
native-monitor-regression.assertion-preservation: Created identity and payload checks remain. Native deletion/up-down tests wait for initial up, then clear observed startup events so the newly emitted initial down cannot satisfy later down assertions.

native-rsvp-carrier.trigger: Established bypass a and b; primary tunnel 93 Up with successful primary UDP; h.routes.LinkSetDown(primary).
expected-green-boundary: H logs local repair onto bypass and LSP locally repaired on link failure.
show rsvp-te fast-reroute contains tunnel-id 93 with protection-in-use true.
H carries protected PATH with an alternate assigned sender through bypass-a and the a outer label.
H ingress FEC has [a.OutLabel, primaryM.InLabel] over bypass-a and repaired-native UDP arrives.
do-not-change: No changes to the existing protection-in-use oracle.
native-rsvp-carrier.claim-limit: A succeeding link-down wait alone proves notification-to-repair state, not all subsequent native checks or RFC conformance.

dependency-probe.change: registerRSVPTE declares interface as a dependency.
dependency-probe.discrimination: Run an RSVP-only native configuration without OSPF or an explicit interface component block, establish a directly addressed ordinary LSP, and lower its pre-existing downstream link. Require the local path-error/teardown outcome. Removing only interface from the RSVP dependency list must prevent the native notification producer from loading and leave this condition unmet.
dependency-probe.boundary: The full retained producer includes OSPF, whose interface dependency masks this independent registration defect; its green cannot alone prove this dependency repair.

still-missing-capability: No absent facility feature was implemented. Multi-interface link-down matching still depends on configured address-prefix membership; precise stored forwarding-interface matching remains outside this repair.
